ActorTalk: "Dreamglow Gardens" is a fitting name. No... even in my dreams, I've never seen foliage so lush.
I can almost hear them singing.
My grandfather used to say: If you listen with your heart, you can hear the voice of plants.

The forests and tundra of the Arctic are nothing like this. They're silent, solemn... only whispering their songs when spring returns. People hold song gatherings then, celebrating the sun and melting snow with the land itself.
You can bring companions to those gatherings... If we ever get the chance, come with me, Commandant.
You've always had a strong connection to nature.
